pages.text: Four bridges lead from the landing to the four sanctums. Speak to a Watcher to begin its trial: Solenne's climb (east), Vael's hunt (west), Orrin's forge of light (south) and Ilyra's library (north).$(br2)Each completed trial grants that Watcher's $(l)Mark$() and its $(l)favour$() – but rival Watchers grow cooler: Solenne and Vael, Orrin and Ilyra.
